```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U13_4

1. Add a new Symptom
   - Start at the Symptom List screen
   - Click "Add Symptom" button
   - Enter Symptom name "Headache"
   - Confirm "Add Symptom"
   - Verify Symptom "Headache" is added to the list

2. View and Update Symptom Details
   - Start at the Symptom List screen
   - Select Symptom "Headache"
   - Click "Edit Symptom" button
   - Update Symptom description to "Severe headache"
   - Confirm "Save"
   - Verify Symptom description is "Severe headache"

3. Delete Symptom Details
   - Start at the Symptom List screen
   - Select Symptom "Headache"
   - Click "Delete Symptom" button
   - Confirm "Delete"
   - Verify Symptom "Headache" is removed from the list
   - Check for Consultation requests with "Headache"
   - Verify "Headache" is not present in any Consultation requests

  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Add a new Symptom", "req_ids": ["Req-4/1"], "kind": "positive",
